hook.name: LiqpadLaunchHook
hook.description: Factory-gated launch pool hook for B20/VVV token pairs. Collects a 1% fee on each swap: B20 (launch token) fees are burned via the token contract, while VVV fees are routed to an immutable FeeRouter that splits 70% to the token creator and 30% to the protocol. Only pools registered and initialized by the factory may be swapped.
